Class StateScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.StateScenarios
final class StateScenarios extends Object
Cross-loader bucket-state scenarios; each loader wraps every method as a GameTest.

    pristine_bucket_reads_do_not_attach_components(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)

    (package private) static void
    released_bucket_state_loads_in_current_form(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Manual: on 1.21.1, save a world holding a Big Bucket of water (on Forge, a modded fluid with variant data), a Mob Bucket of pigs, and a Junk Bucket holding items and a filled Big Bucket; open it on this version and confirm every content survives.
    (package private) static void
    stored_item_reads_are_detached_and_empty_writes_clean_components(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Automation-only: mutates returned stored-item copies and writes empties to verify reads are detached and empty state is removed.
    (package private) static void
    stored_items_round_trip_with_order_counts_and_tags(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Automation-only: serializes and reads stored item entries and verifies order, counts, and component data round-trip.
    (package private) static void
    unreadable_storage_entries_are_set_aside_and_restored(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Manual: put an item from another mod into a Junk Bucket, remove that mod, and reload; the rest of the bucket loads, its tooltip reports the entry set aside, and restoring the mod and reloading returns the item to the bucket when there is room.
    (package private) static void
    vanilla_fluids_report_their_bucket_sounds(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Automation-only: asks the loader for water and lava bucket sounds and verifies each reports the vanilla bucket's own fill and empty sound.

    variable_stack_size_tracks_fill_state(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
